Macrons

Consonantal i

Household, washing & chores

mow verb

also mow the lawn

classical

M-O s.v. lawn: mow the lawn
Verg. G. 1.290

prātum tondēre

Examples

  • Avus prātum tondet; nōlī ad māchinam accēdere.

    Grandpa is mowing the lawn; don’t go near the mower.composed

Other words

  • prātulum resecāre

    also used · modern · Traupman 338

  • grāmen resecāre

    also used · modern · Traupman 38

See also lawn, lawnmower.

SourcesLewis & Short: tondeo · Lewis & Short: reseco
